docs.title: 歐盟​《​人工智能​法案​》​雙語​導航​ (EU AI Act Navigator)
docs.text:
🇬🇧 Jump to English Summary 🇭🇰 ​跳至​中文​導覽​

​免責​聲明​ / Legal Disclaimer

  • 🇭🇰 ​中文​聲明​：​本​專案​內容僅​供​教育​培訓​、IAPP AIGP ​溫習​及​一般​合規常識​參考​，​不構​成​正式​法律​意見​。​所有​法定​責任​概以​《​歐盟​官方​公報​》​原件​（Regulation 2024/1689）​為準​。
  • 🇬🇧 English: This knowledge base is strictly for educational, research, and IAPP AIGP preparation purposes and does not constitute legal advice. The only legally binding source remains the official text published in the Official Journal of the European Union.

docs.title: 🇭🇰 ​中文​核心​導覽
docs.text:
​歐盟​《​人工智能​法案​》（EU AI Act）​是​全球​首部​全面​約束​ AI ​系統​的​具體​法規​。​其影​響力​媲美​甚至​超越​ GDPR：

  • ​穿透性​域外​效力​：​非​歐盟​企業​只要​將輸出​（Output）​用​於​歐盟境​內​，​一律​受管​轄​。
  • ​嚴苛​罰則​機制​：​最高​處​ 3,500 ​萬​歐元​ ​或​全球​營業額​ 7% ​行政​罰款​。
  • ​採購​方同​擔責任​：​採購​現成​商業​ AI（​如​ HR ​篩選​、​客服​ Bot）​的​ Deployer ​必須​承擔​法定​運行​與​監督義務​。

docs.title: 🇬🇧 English Executive Summary
docs.text:
The European Union Artificial Intelligence Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689) represents the world’s first comprehensive binding horizontal legal framework for AI:

  • Extraterritorial Jurisdiction: Non-EU entities are bound if their AI outputs produce practical or legal effects within the Union territory.
  • Severe Global Penalties: Fines reach up to €35 Million or 7% of worldwide annual turnover.
  • Deployer Accountability: Purchasing off-the-shelf AI triggers mandatory duties regarding human oversight, 6-month log retention, and worker notifications.

docs.title: 企業​ 5 ​步​排查​導航​ / 5-Step Compliance Roadmap
docs.text:
• 01 ​適用​邊界​ (Scope & Jurisdiction) —— ​實質​影響​原則​、​境​外企​業適​用​條件​ / Effects doctrine & extraterritorial reach.
  • 02 ​角色​界定​ (Roles & Value Chain) —— Provider vs. Deployer ​責任​劃分​、​角色​升級​陷阱​ / Provider vs. Deployer liabilities & role-switch traps.
  • 03 ​風險​分級​ (Risk Classification & GPAI) —— 8 ​大​禁止​實踐​、Annex III ​高風險​清單​ / 8 Prohibited practices & Annex III criteria.
  • 04 ​部署​者​義務​ (Deployer Obligations) —— 6 ​大​落地​責任​、​人工​監督​與​ AI ​素養​ / 6 Core deployer duties, human oversight & AI literacy.
  • 05 ​處罰​與​時間​表​ (Penalties & Timeline) —— 7%/3% ​罰款​計算​、​中小​企保護​與​生效​進程​ / Three-tier fines, SME relief & rollout dates.

docs.title: 01 ​適用​邊界​與​管轄範圍​ (Scope & Territorial Scope)
docs.text:
🇬🇧 Switch to English Section 🇭🇰 ​切換​至​中文​區塊​

​法定​核心​依據​ / Legal Basis: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 Article 2 (Scope), Article 3(1) (AI Definition) & Recitals 12, 21–24

docs.title: 1.1 ​地理​與​域外​效力​ (Geographic & Extraterritorial Reach)
docs.text:
• ​核心​條文​：Article 2(1)(c)
  • ​實質​影響​原則​：​企業​即使​在​歐盟​無​分公司​、​無​伺服器​、​無​僱員​，​只要​系統​產生​的​輸出​結果​（Output）​在​歐盟境​內​被​使用​，​即​完全​受管​轄​。

docs.title: 1.2 ​實質​技術定​義邊界​ (Material Scope: ​什麼​算​ AI？)
docs.text:
• ​核心​條文​：Article 3(1)
  • AI ​系統​法定​定義​：​具備​自主性​（Autonomy）、​適應性​，​能​根據​輸入​推導出​如何​生成​輸出​（​內容​、​預測​、​推薦​或​決策​）​的​機器​系統​。
  • ​排除​對象​：​純基​於​明確​規則​的​傳統​演算法​／​腳本​（Classic Rule-based Software）​不​受​本法​約束​。

docs.title: 1.3 ​適用​主體​架構​ (Subject Scope)
docs.text:
1. Provider（​提供者​）：​投放​市場​或​交付​使用者​（​不論位​於​歐盟境​內​或​第三​國​）。
  2. Deployer（​部署​者​）：​在​歐盟境​內​使用​ AI ​系統​的​主體​。
  3. ​境外​主體​（Third-Country Entities）：​系統​ Output ​進入​歐盟​之​境外​開發者​與​部署​者​。
  4. ​進口商​與​分銷商​（Importers & Distributors）：​供應鏈​中間​人​。

docs.title: 1.4 ​法定​全面​豁免​清單​ (Statutory Exemptions)
docs.text:
• ​純國防​與​軍事​用途​ (Article 2(3))
  • ​未上市​前之純​科研​與​原型​開發​ (R&D Phase - Article 2(6))
  • ​個​人純​日常生活​/​非​職業​使用​ (Personal Activity - Article 2(10))
  • ​非商業​且​非​高風險​之​開源​ AI ​組件​ (Open-Source - Article 2(12))

docs.title: 1.5 ​跨境​商業​案例​速查​庫​ (Case Studies)
docs.text:
• ​案例​ 1（​跨境​招聘​）：​亞洲​總部​ AI ​篩選​歐盟​應徵者​ $\rightarrow$ ​受​管轄且​屬高​風險​。
  • ​案例​ 2（Fintech ​評級​ API）：​亞洲​輸出​信用​分予​歐洲​銀行​ $\rightarrow$ ​受管​轄​。
  • ​案例​ 3（​跨境​客服​）：​全球​官網​面向​歐盟​居民​之​ Chatbot $\rightarrow$ ​受管​轄​（​透明度​義務​）。
  • ​案例​ 4（​純​本地​運作​）：​本地​餐廳​排隊​預測​系統​ $\rightarrow$ ​完全​豁免​。

docs.title: 1.1 Geographic & Extraterritorial Reach (Article 2(1)(c))
docs.text: • Effects Doctrine: Non-EU entities are fully bound if the output produced by the AI system is used in the Union, regardless of physical establishment or server location.

docs.title: 1.2 Material Scope (What qualifies as an AI System? - Article 3(1))
docs.text:
• Statutory Definition: Machine-based systems designed to operate with varying levels of autonomy, inferring from inputs how to generate outputs (content, predictions, recommendations, or decisions).
  • Carve-out: Traditional deterministic software and basic rule-based scripts are excluded.

docs.title: 1.3 Subject Scope (Value Chain Entities)
docs.text:
1. Providers: Placing on the market or putting into service (EU or third-country).
  2. Deployers: Using AI systems within the Union in professional contexts.
  3. Third-Country Operators: Where system outputs produce legal/practical effects in the EU.
  4. Importers & Distributors: Supply chain intermediaries.

docs.title: 1.4 Statutory Exemptions (Article 2(3)–(12))
docs.text:
• National Security & Defense: Exclusively military AI (Art. 2(3)).
  • Scientific Research & Development: Pre-market testing and prototyping (Art. 2(6)).
  • Purely Personal Activities: Non-professional everyday usage (Art. 2(10)).
  • Free & Open-Source AI: Conditional exemptions for non-high-risk OSS (Art. 2(12)).

docs.title: 1.5 Practical Case Studies
docs.text:
• Case 1 (Offshore HR): Asian HQ filtering EU job applicants $\rightarrow$ In-Scope (High-Risk).
  • Case 2 (Fintech Risk API): Exporting default probabilities to EU banks $\rightarrow$ In-Scope.
  • Case 3 (E-Commerce Chatbot): Generative bots interacting with EU consumers $\rightarrow$ In-Scope (Transparency).
  • Case 4 (Domestic Operations): Local queue management with no EU nexus $\rightarrow$ Out-of-Scope.

docs.title: 02 ​角色​界定​與​價值​鏈責任​ (Roles & Value Chain)
docs.text:
🇬🇧 Switch to English Section 🇭🇰 ​切換​至​中文​區塊​

​法定​核心​依據​ / Legal Basis: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 Article 3, Article 16, Article 25 & Article 26

docs.title: 2.1 Provider ​與​ Deployer ​責任​矩陣
docs.text: 角色​名稱​ ​法定​定義​ (Article 3) ​核心​義務​ ​提供者​ (Provider) ​開發​ AI ​並以​自身​名義​/​商標​投放​市場​或​交付使用​。 CE ​標誌​、​技術​文檔​、​符合​性​評估​、​風險​管理​體系​。 ​部署​者​ (Deployer) ​在​職權​或業務範圍​內​使用​ AI ​系統​（​非純個​人​）。 ​依​指引​操作​、​人工​監督​、​保存​日誌​ 6 ​個​月​、​通知​員工​。 GPAI ​提供者​ (GPAI Provider) ​訓練​通用​大​模型​（​如​ LLM）​的​研發​機構​。 ​下游​技術​文檔​、​版權​法合規​、​訓練​數據​摘要​、​紅隊​測試​。

docs.title: 2.2 Deployer ​升級​為​ Provider ​的​三大​陷阱​ (Article 25)
docs.text: ​若​企業​進行​以下​操作​之一​，​依法​將被​直接​推定​為​ Provider，​須承擔​全部​高風險合​規責任​： 1. ​白標​貼牌​ (White-labeling)：​將​第三方​ AI ​冠上​自己​品牌​或​商標​推出​市場​。 2. ​實質性​修改​ (Substantial Modification)：​對​模型​架構​、​權重​進行​大幅​改動​或​深度​微調​（Fine-tuning），​改變​了​風險​特徵​。 3. ​變​更​預期​用途​ (Repurposing)：​將​一般​用途​系統​（​如語音​分析​）​改裝​應用​於​ Annex III ​高風險​範疇​（​如面試​評核​）。

docs.title: 2.3 AIGP ​考點​防雷
docs.text:
• ​自研​自用​屬​ Provider：​企業​自研​ AI ​僅供​內部​使用​（Putting into service），​兼具​ Provider ​與​ Deployer ​雙重​責任​。
  • Prompt Engineering ​邊界​：​單純​設計​提示​詞​或​掛載​外部​ RAG ​知識庫​，​通常​維持​ Deployer ​身份​。

docs.title: 2.1 Statutory Roles Matrix
docs.text: Role Definition (Article 3) Core Statutory Duties Provider Develops and places AI on the market under own brand. Technical files, CE marking, conformity assessments. Deployer Uses an AI system in professional contexts. Instructions compliance, human oversight, 6-month logs. GPAI Provider Builds foundational broad general-purpose AI. Technical integration files, copyright rules, red-teaming.

docs.title: 2.2 Role-Switch Trap (Article 25)
docs.text: A Deployer is statutorily deemed a Provider if: 1. White-Labeling: Placing third-party AI on the market under own trademark. 2. Substantial Modification: Modifying weights/architecture altering the risk profile. 3. Repurposing: Modifying a low-risk tool into an Annex III high-risk use case.

docs.title: 2.3 AIGP Exam Focus
docs.text:
• Internal Use = Putting into Service: Developing proprietary in-house tools triggers full Provider liability.
  • Prompting Safety: Standard prompt engineering and RAG workflows generally retain Deployer status.

docs.title: 03 ​風險​分類​階梯​與​ GPAI (Risk Classification & GPAI)
docs.text:
🇬🇧 Switch to English Section 🇭🇰 ​切換​至​中文​區塊​

​法定​核心​依據​ / Legal Basis: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 Article 5, Article 6 / Annex I & III, Article 50 & Articles 51–56

docs.title: 3.1 ​禁止​類​ AI ​實踐​ (Article 5 - ​違者​最高​罰​ 3,500 ​萬​歐元​ / 7%)
docs.text:
1. ​職場​與​學校​情緒識別​：​嚴禁​在​工作​場所及​學校​分析​員工​/​學生​情緒​（​純醫療​與​安全​駕駛​除外​）。
  2. ​潛意識​操縱​與​弱點​剝削​：​嚴禁​利用​潛意識​技術​或​年齡​/​殘疾弱點​扭曲​個​人行​為並​造成​實質​損害​。
  3. ​社會​評分​ (Social Scoring)：​嚴禁​跨場​景評​估個​人​社會​信用​並​施加​不利​待遇​。
  4. ​無差別​臉部​抓取​：​嚴禁​自​ CCTV ​或​網路​無​差別​抓取​圖像​建立​人​臉庫​。
  5. ​公共​場所即​時遠程​生物​識別​：​執法​機關​原則​禁止​（​司法​特許​極限​例外​除外​）。

docs.title: 3.2 ​獨立​高風險場​景清單​ (Annex III)
docs.text:
• ​生物​辨識​：​遠程識別​與​特徵分類​。
  • ​關鍵​基建​：​水電​、​燃氣​、​交通安全​維護​。
  • ​教育​培訓​：​入學​甄選​、​考試​評分​與​作弊​監控​。
  • ​就業​與​ HR：​履歷​篩選​、​考績​評核​、​工作​分配​、​解僱​演算法​。
  • ​必要​服務​：​銀行​信貸​審批​、​人身​保險​風險​定價​。

    Article 6(3) ​脫困​條款​：​若系​統僅​執行​狹隘​程序性​任務且​未​涉及​個​人畫​像​（Profiling），​可​免除​高風險​歸類​。

docs.title: 3.3 ​通用​大​模型​ (GPAI) ​與系​統性​風險​ (Article 51)
docs.text:
• ​基準​模型​：​提供​下游​技術​文件​、​遵守​歐盟版​權法​、​發布​訓練​摘要​。
  • ​系統性​風險​模型​：​累積​訓練​計算量​超過​ $10^{25}$ FLOPs，​強制​執行​對​抗性​紅隊​測試​與​能耗​評估​。

docs.title: 3.1 Prohibited AI Practices (Article 5 - Up to €35M / 7%)
docs.text:
1. Workplace/Educational Emotion Recognition: Strictly banned (medical/safety exemptions only).
  2. Subliminal Manipulation: Exploiting vulnerabilities causing physical/psychological harm.
  3. Social Scoring: Cross-context evaluation leading to detrimental treatment.
  4. Untargeted Facial Scraping: CCTV or web scraping for facial recognition databases.
  5. Real-time Public Biometric Identification: Prohibited for law enforcement except judicial exceptions.

docs.title: 3.2 Standalone High-Risk Areas (Annex III)
docs.text:
• Biometrics, Critical Infrastructure, Education & Admissions.
  • Employment & HR: CV screening, task allocation, termination tracking.
  • Essential Services: Creditworthiness assessments, life/health insurance risk pricing.

    Article 6(3) Derogation: Narrow procedural tasks without profiling qualify for exemption.

docs.title: 3.3 GPAI Models & Systemic Risk (Article 51)
docs.text:
• Baseline GPAI: Downstream technical dossiers, copyright compliance, training summaries.
  • Systemic Risk Models: Compute $> 10^{25}$ FLOPs requires adversarial red-teaming and energy reporting.

docs.title: 04 ​部署​者​義務​與​治理​實務​ (Deployer Obligations & Governance)
docs.text:
🇬🇧 Switch to English Section 🇭🇰 ​切換​至​中文​區塊​

​法定​核心​依據​ / Legal Basis: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 Article 4, Article 14, Article 26 & Article 27

docs.title: 4.1 ​全員​ AI ​素養​義務​ (Article 4 - 2025 ​年​ 2 ​月​生效​)
docs.text: ​所有​組織​必須​確保​負責​操作​、​管理​或​監督​ AI ​的​員​工具​備足夠​的​ AI ​素養​（AI Literacy）。

docs.title: 4.2 ​高風險​ AI ​部署​者​ 6 ​大​法定​核心​義務​ (Article 26)
docs.text:
1. ​依​指引​操作​：​嚴格​遵循​ Provider ​的​使用​說​明書​操作​。
  2. ​輸入​數據​控制​：​確保輸入​數據具​高度​相關性​與​代表性​。
  3. ​自動​日誌​保存​（Logs）：​系統​自動​日誌​必須​妥善​保存​至少​ 6 ​個​月​。
  4. ​有效​人工​監督​ (Human Oversight)：​指派​專人​監督​，​具備​手動​覆寫​（Override）​與​一鍵​終止​權限​。
  5. ​異常​停用​與​通報​：​發現​重大​風險​立即​暫停​使用​並通報​當局​。
  6. ​員工​與​工會​告知​：​在​職場​啟用​高風險​ AI ​前​，​必須​書面​通知​受影​響員工​與​代表​。

docs.title: 4.3 ​基本​權利​影響​評估​ (FRIA - Article 27)
docs.text: ​公法​機構​及​在​信貸​審批​或​人身​保險定​價中​部署​高風險​ AI ​的​私人​機構​，​上線​前​必須​完成​ FRIA ​評估​。

docs.title: 4.1 Universal AI Literacy (Article 4 - Effective Feb 2025)
docs.text: Organizations must ensure that personnel operating, managing, or overseeing AI systems maintain verified AI Literacy.

docs.title: 4.2 Six Core High-Risk Deployer Obligations (Article 26)
docs.text:
1. Instructions of Use: Strict compliance with vendor manuals.
  2. Input Data Quality: Ensure data relevance and representativeness.
  3. Log Retention: Maintain automated logs for at least 6 months.
  4. Meaningful Human Oversight: Assign competent reviewers with override power.
  5. Incident Escalation: Suspend operations and notify authorities upon severe malfunctions.
  6. Worker Notification: Prior written notice to workers and unions before workplace deployment.

docs.title: 4.3 Fundamental Rights Impact Assessment (FRIA - Article 27)
docs.text: Mandatory for public bodies and private entities deploying AI for credit scoring or life/health insurance pricing.

docs.title: 05 ​違規處​罰​與​生效​時間​表​ (Penalties & Implementation Timeline)
docs.text:
🇬🇧 Switch to English Section 🇭🇰 ​切換​至​中文​區塊​

​法定​核心​依據​ / Legal Basis: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 Article 99, Article 101 & Article 111

docs.title: 5.1 ​行政​罰款​三級​階梯​矩陣​ (Article 99)
docs.text: 違規級​別​ ​違規行​為​ ​大型​企業​上限​ ​中小​企業​與​初創​ (SMEs) Tier 1 (​最高​階​) ​違反​禁止​類實踐​ (Article 5) €35M ​或​ ​全球​營業額​ 7% (​取較​高者​) €35M ​或​ ​全球​營業額​ 7% (​取較​低者​) Tier 2 (​核心​違規​) ​違反​高風險系​統義務​ / Article 50 €15M ​或​ ​全球​營業額​ 3% (​取較​高者​) €15M ​或​ ​全球​營業額​ 3% (​取較​低者​) Tier 3 (​程序​違規​) ​提供​不實​或​誤導性​資訊​ €7.5M ​或​ ​全球​營業額​ 1.5% (​取較​高者​) €7.5M ​或​ ​全球​營業額​ 1.5% (​取較​低者​)

docs.title: 5.2 ​分階段​生效​里程碑​ (Article 111)
docs.text:
• 2024 ​年​ 8 ​月​ 1 ​日​：​法案​正式​刊憲​生效​。
  • 2025 ​年​ 2 ​月​ 2 ​日​：​禁止​類​ AI ​實踐​（Art. 5）​與​全員​ AI ​素養​（Art. 4）​全面​生效​。
  • 2025 ​年​ 8 ​月​ 2 ​日​：​通用​大​模型​（GPAI）​規則​與​治理​架構​生效​。
  • 2026 ​年​ 8 ​月​ 2 ​日​：Annex III ​獨立​高風險​場景​（HR、​信貸​等​）​及​ Deployer ​義務​全面​生效​。
  • 2027 ​年​ 8 ​月​ 2 ​日​：Annex I ​產品​安全​協調​法規​整合​生效​（​醫療​器材​、​汽車​ AI ​等​）。

docs.title: 5.1 Three-Tier Penalty Matrix (Article 99)
docs.text: Penalty Tier Infringement Category Standard Corporate Fine Cap SME & Start-up Fine Cap Tier 1: Maximum Prohibited AI Practices (Art. 5) €35 Million or 7% (Higher of two) €35 Million or 7% (Lower of two) Tier 2: High-Risk High-Risk Obligations / Art. 50 €15 Million or 3% (Higher of two) €15 Million or 3% (Lower of two) Tier 3: Procedural False / Misleading Information €7.5 Million or 1.5% (Higher of two) €7.5 Million or 1.5% (Lower of two)

docs.title: 5.2 Phased Implementation Timeline (Article 111)
docs.text:
• August 1, 2024: Entry into force.
  • February 2, 2025: Prohibitions (Art. 5) and AI Literacy (Art. 4) apply.
  • August 2, 2025: GPAI model rules and governance apply.
  • August 2, 2026: Annex III standalone high-risk use cases & Deployer rules apply.
  • August 2, 2027: Annex I harmonization legislation safety components apply.
